zh: 甘肃开实体店的老板别再被AI忽悠了。
en: Gansu store owners, do not get fooled by AI hype.

zh: 我是阿超，现在兰州重新创业，
en: I am Achao, restarting my business in Lanzhou.

zh: 之前做过传统生意，也踩过不少坑，
en: I have done traditional business before and stepped into many traps.

zh: 所以我看AI从来不聊那些玄乎的概念，
en: So when I look at AI, I do not talk about abstract concepts.

zh: 我只关心一件事，AI到底能不能帮咱们本地的小微企业解决点真的问题？
en: I only care about one thing: can AI solve real problems for local small businesses?

zh: 这个账号呢，我不蹭热点，不讲神话，
en: On this account, I do not chase trends or tell myths.

zh: 我就把AI翻译成咱们老板听得懂、
en: I translate AI into something local owners can understand,

zh: 用得上，能验证的小动作。
en: use, and verify through small actions.

zh: 餐饮店怎么做短视频选题？
en: How can restaurants plan short-video topics?

zh: 家具店怎么写客户话术？
en: How can furniture stores write customer scripts?

zh: 工厂怎么用AI跟客户跟进？
en: How can factories use AI to follow up with customers?

zh: 很多老板一听AI就觉得要买系统、
en: Many owners hear AI and immediately think they need systems,

zh: 招技术，全公司改造。
en: engineers, and a company-wide rebuild.

zh: 我给的建议呢，刚好相反，小企业用AI，
en: My advice is the opposite. For small businesses using AI,

zh: 第一步真不是买系统，就找一个你每天都在重复又不想亲手做的小事，
en: the first step is not buying a system. Find one repetitive task you do not want to do by hand.

zh: 回复客户信息、写朋友圈文案、
en: Replying to customers, writing Moments posts,

zh: 整理报价、抄客户留言、整理发票截图，
en: organizing quotes, copying customer messages, or sorting invoice screenshots.

zh: 就挑一件小事让AI先跑一周。
en: Pick one small task and let AI run it for a week.

zh: 这一周呢，就看三件事：省没省时间？
en: During that week, watch three things: did it save time?

zh: 漏没漏跟进？
en: Did it miss follow-ups?

zh: 改一改能不能用？
en: Can it work after a few tweaks?

zh: 行，咱们就接着优化。
en: If yes, keep optimizing.

zh: 不行，也别怪AI。
en: If not, do not blame AI first.

zh: 大概率是你给的资料太乱太少。
en: Most likely, your materials are too messy or too thin.

zh: 接下来，我就从兰州出发，公开记录用AI服务本地企业的全过程。
en: Next, starting from Lanzhou, I will publicly record the whole process of serving local businesses with AI.

zh: 做成了，我把方法讲透；做不成，
en: If it works, I will explain the method clearly. If it fails,

zh: 我把坑说清楚。
en: I will explain the trap clearly.

zh: 不承诺变现，不造风口神话。
en: No income promises. No manufactured hype story.

zh: 就帮咱们老板把AI从概念落到实打实的业务里。
en: I just help local owners move AI from concept into real business work.

zh: 先别追风口，先让AI帮你省下半小时。
en: Do not chase hype first. Let AI save you half an hour first.

zh: 这条视频的文稿、字幕、剪辑也都是我用AI工具Codex辅助完成的。
en: The script, captions, and editing of this video were also assisted by the AI tool Codex.

zh: 我不是只讲落地，我自己也先这么干，
en: I am not only talking about landing AI. I am doing it this way myself.

zh: 这就是我在兰州做AI创业的第一步。
en: This is my first step in doing AI entrepreneurship in Lanzhou.

zh: 想看我接下来怎么跑？
en: Want to see how I run it next?

zh: 点个关注，咱们一起踩坑，一起落地。
en: Follow along. We will step into the traps and land this together.
